title: Compact matrix cost overview — handoff & ops feedback
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design, prototype, and hand off a compact matrix-style cost overview tile for the Redwood Console dashboard. Goals: show multi-metric density (tokens, cost, latency, requests) across models and routes in a 2×N matrix that fits a dashboard row; preserve readability at small sizes; ensure keyboard focus and screen-reader clarity; provide motion states for live updates and rollout indicators. This ticket covers visual polish iterations after stakeholder review, redlines for the dev handoff, QA checklists, and an ops feedback loop to validate performance constraints.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity Figma files with annotated responsive states (desktop compact and narrow) are delivered
Redlines document with exact spacing, type tokens, color tokens, and motion easing/speeds is attached
A11y checklist passed: color contrast >= 4.5:1 for data labels, keyboard nav order defined, aria-label patterns provided
Prototype link demonstrates live-update motion and can simulate a rollout-change state
Front-end dev PR includes visual unit tests (screenshot diffs) and integration story for dashboard row
Ops/infra acceptance: renders within 10ms of server-provided payload and respects batching placeholders
comments: 2026-02-19 — Ellen Park (PM): Love the density direction. Request: make the token vs cost cells tappable to open route drilldown. Ask infra to confirm approximate payload size for the compact tile API.

2026-02-22 — Marco Liu (Design, assignee): Iterated on tap target sizes — increased interactive area to 44px min while keeping compact grid. Added explicit focus outline for keyboard nav and aria-expanded patterns for drilldown.

2026-02-25 — Rahul Menon (Frontend Eng): Dev note: CSS grid approach works but we need clear tokenization of vertical rhythm to avoid layout shift when numbers update. Suggest baseline transforms for number transitions (fade+translateY 6px).

2026-03-01 — Accessibility review (Tina Gomez): Redlines: adjust data-label contrast to 4.6:1; supply aria-label examples in spec; add guidance for live region updates to avoid screen-reader spam during high-frequency telemetry.

2026-03-03 — Ops (Keisha Owusu): Verified that the compact tile micropayload is ~1.2KB at 200 routes; acceptable. Concern: live-update every 1s may cause CPU spikes on older clients — recommend throttled websocket cadence or server-sent-batch mode.
2026-03-05 — Aisha Patel (Creator): Incorporated Tina's contrast and live-region guidance. Updated prototype to show throttled update states. Preparing final redlines for the dev PR.
2026-03-08 — Marco Liu (Design): Pushed final Figma file and redlines PDF; included an example JSON payload in Confluence and a small component usage guide for the Console team.

2026-03-09 — Product Review (Ellen Park): Minor copy tweak on the rollout microcopy — change 'canary' label to 'trial' for customer-facing clarity. Also requested an optional collapsed state for single-route dashboards.
2026-03-10 — Marco Liu: Updated file names and added collapsed-state variant to Figma. Noted follow-up sub-issue to add e2e tests for collapsed variant (DES-86421).
